purpose: Research only; component evaluation cannot qualify or activate production
rendering: font size 19..33, independent spacing/padding, 20% light blur, 20% mild JPEG, 10% gray foreground; original-pixel BGR48 transform

training.loss: CTC + 0.1 mean time-step KL to frozen teacher

selection: choose baseline or epoch checkpoint by highest development exact-match count; tie lowest development CER, then earliest. Final never selects a checkpoint or inference candidate.
finalOpen: only after checkpoint choice and hash are persisted
safetyControls: separate blank, clipped and multiline probes; damaged/multiline output is never accepted as complete truth from recognizer alone
limits: No real school originals, subjects, people or rooms. No previous consumed comparison strings. No lexicon correction, beam oracle, gold candidate selection, manual output edits, header/structure reconstruction or production edits. CPU and local inference only. No commit/push.
adoption: requires full-document integration with geometry/cell provenance, deterministic validator, <=3 body corrections per document, no hand-entered headers/structure, unseen arbitrary values and confidence/damage gates. Component exact match is insufficient.
